bic_trace_step.reason: In hfsplus_fill_super (fs/hfsplus/super.c), `hfs_brec_read(&fd, &entry, sizeof(entry))` reads a catalog record into the stack-allocated `entry` struct. The function does not verify that the on-disk record size matches the expected `sizeof(entry)`, so a smaller record can leave parts of `entry` uninitialized (like `entry.type` and `entry.folder.id`). These are then used immediately after the call without any additional size validation, matching the root cause of uninitialized stack data consumption.
